parsed.name: GPIB通信适配器
parsed.description: 这是一种将计算机与采用 IEEE-488/GPIB 接口的实验仪器连接起来的通信适配器，常见形式为 GPIB-USB 或 GPIB-以太网桥接器。它用于实验室中对万用表、源表、示波器、频谱仪等台式仪器进行远程控制、命令发送和数据采集。
parsed.description_en: This is a communication adapter that links a computer to laboratory instruments using the IEEE-488/GPIB interface, commonly as a GPIB-to-USB or GPIB-to-Ethernet bridge. It is used in labs for remote control, command transmission, and data acquisition from bench instruments such as multimeters, source meters, oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers.

actions.description: 获取或设置 GPIB 地址和下游地址。
actions.description_en: Get or set the GPIB address and downstream address.

actions.description: 关闭与 GPIB 适配器的连接。

actions.description: 获取或设置 EOI 使用状态。

actions.description: 获取或设置结束字符串（EOS）字符。
actions.description_en: Get or set the end-of-string (EOS) character.
